page.layout: Running head at top centre: POLITICI INDEX. Two printed columns of an index on the right page, left column then right column, with a heading S. above the left column. Page number 4 at the foot right with signature Ss. At the left edge, part of the preceding page: a fragment of a text column with marginal numbers, which is show-through of the neighbouring page and is left out.

main_text.head: S.
main_text.l: Salus aliorum per nos, vel inuitos, quaerenda 58. in amplitudine consilij est 147
Scelera 191, 320, 414. impetu valeant 163. principum togi silerique nequeunt 61
Sceptrum imperij numquam peregrino tradendum sit 46
Scire plus quam satis sit, intemperantiae genus est 66

page.notes: Left-margin fragments belong to the facing page and are not transcribed. Some German words are in black letter (Schantzenmeister, Scheppenstul, Schutzherren) but set as printed here; the black letter marks were not reliably distinguishable. The "S." above the left column is a section letter. Printed "s" forms have been read as s.
